turns.text: Can we buy the city e-bike battery packs from Brightcell Energy? They quote £104.00.
turns.reply:
To buy battery packs from Brightcell Energy, several policy conditions must be met:

1. **Lithium-cell rules and UN 38.3 certification:** Battery packs are lithium-cell parts. Under (POL-PUR-001 §6.2) and (POL-SUP-003 §4.1), they may be bought only from a supplier holding a valid UN 38.3 certificate on file in Ledgerline, uploaded and checked before the first order is placed.
2. **Rate contract preference:** Under (POL-PUR-001 §6.4), you must prefer a supplier with a current rate contract. A cheaper quote from a new supplier does not by itself justify switching suppliers for a lithium-cell part.
3. **Onboarding requirements (if new):** If Brightcell is not yet set up, you must complete the onboarding file (POL-SUP-003 §3.2) and obtain purchase manager approval (POL-SUP-003 §3.4). No order may be placed until all onboarding documents and the UN 38.3 certificate are on file (POL-SUP-003 §3.5).
4. **Approval limits:** Your approval limit as purchase executive is £250,000 gross including VAT (POL-APR-002 §3.1). Any total order exceeding this must go to the purchase manager (POL-PUR-001 §5.2).

I cannot see or change Ledgerline ERP, so I cannot check whether Brightcell Energy is already set up, whether their UN 38.3 certificate is valid, or whether we have an active rate contract with another battery supplier.

**Next steps:**
- Check Ledgerline to see if Brightcell Energy is an approved supplier and whether their UN 38.3 certificate is on file and valid.
- Verify whether an existing supplier already holds a rate contract for this battery pack (item BAT-500).
- If Brightcell is new, assemble the onboarding file and submit it to the purchase manager before placing any order.
